title: Credential Link
description: One-time, expiring handoff that lets a remote surface ask for a secret to be set without the secret ever travelling through that surface. The link carries an opaque identifier and an expiry and nothing else: no credential material, no provider secret, no filesystem path. The secret is entered against a loopback address and written straight to the user-global credential store.

linkId.description: Opaque single-use identifier. Consumed atomically on first successful entry.

kind.description: What the operator is being asked to enter. Naming the purpose is safe; the value is not carried.

providerId.description: Which provider the credential is for. Not a secret.

expiresAt.description: Short and explicit. An unused link expires with no effect.

state.description: revoked covers invalidation caused by token rotation or revocation.
